text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, I participated as a chaperone for
the academy's recreational barbecue event.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Starting fires, cooking, and digging in!
Bonds deepened through teamwork—now this is youth!
Let's all have a blast, everyone! Ohhh!
choice_data_list: Yeah, make sure to enjoy yourself!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, looks like the fire is dying out... could you lend me a hand fan?
I'll keep fanning it until it blazes up properly.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see, knives make you nervous... leave it to me then.
We need cabbage chopped for ten servings of yakisoba, right?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eh, this? It's non-burnable trash from each group.
If we collect and sort it periodically now,
cleaning up later will be much easier.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Miracle?
Has she just been running around helping out other groups this whole time...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We came all this way for a barbecue,
but at this rate she's just gonna exhaust herself!
I'll take over for her!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
How's this group doing over here~?
If anything's giving you trouble, don't hesitate to speak up!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! This group is having a real blast!
Just make sure not to go too wild over here, okay~!?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Bamboo...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yes. Earlier when I was making the rounds like that,
she called out to me.
She told me she'd take over so I could go enjoy myself.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
But this way, Bamboo is the one
who won't get to enjoy herself at all...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy she was being considerate of me.
However... I don't think this is the right way.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because if she wants me to enjoy myself,
I want the exact same thing for Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I could understand not wanting to brush aside Bamboo Memory's
thoughtfulness. But at this rate, KS Miracle wouldn't
be able to enjoy herself either. So――
choice_data_list: Let's go talk to her together.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Would that be okay?
Thank goodness... that really helps a lot.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo, thanks for doing the rounds.
Are you feeling tired from running around so much? Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine!
After all, I want Miracle and everyone else
to have fun!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...About that.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You know, if we're going to have fun,
I'd really love to enjoy it together with you, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I want 'everyone' to have a good time too.
And Bamboo, that 'everyone' includes you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
M-Miracle...!
You were thinking about me like that too...!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Guh! Lesson learned, lesson learned!
I got way too carried away on my own!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad.
Can we enjoy ourselves together now?
choice_data_list: Make sure you eat your fill too.
You eat your fill as well, alright?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Roger that!
From here on out, I'm gonna eat, eat, and chow down like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, and I wanna do a campfire too!
We're gonna do everything youthful under the sun!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Miracle, Trainer-san!
And me too—'all of us' together!!!
